channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Beverly Area Planning Association To Focus On Community Health With Expo
item.description: The annual Community Health Expo scheduled for Saturday in Beverly will connect residents with over 50 local health and wellness vendors.

item.title: City Sues For Millions In Damages After ‘Worst Landowner’ Property Auction Fails
item.description: It’s the latest controversy surrounding land owned by Suzie B. Wilson and her sister Swedlana Dass, who have been caught in a legal web since a 2023 investigation by Illinois Answers Project and Block Club Chicago revealed they owed $15 million in unpaid tickets.

item.title: Humboldt Park’s Collaboraction Theatre Company Opens With Memory Play ‘Trial In The Delta’
item.description: "Trial in the Delta: The Murder of Emmett Till" will launch Friday as the first show in Collaboraction's new theater inside the Kimball Arts.

item.title: Kennedy-King College’s Statesmen Market Opens In Englewood With Free Groceries For Students
item.description: Sixty percent of students at Kennedy-King College identify as food insecure, according to a 2024 study. The expanded market will provide free, fresh food to students and their families.

item.title: 12 Ways To Celebrate Galentine’s Day in Chicago
item.description: Hit the town with your best gal pals for a dance party, a wine walk, a drag brunch, a discount fitness class and, of course, bottomless mimosas.

item.title: Aida Flores Again Running For 25th Ward Aldermanic Seat
item.description: The Pilsen native, community organizer and educator announced her plan to run for a third time against incumbent Ald. Byron Sigcho-Lopez. Flores lost to him by 5 percentage points in 2023.

item.title: It’s A ‘New Era’ For The Chicago Reader As Iconic Alt-Weekly Shifts To Monthly Magazine
item.description: The Reader has struggled in recent years amid funding gaps and administration changes. Editor-in-Chief Sarah Conway says she plans to honor the paper's history while focusing on its future.

item.title: South Side Soul Legend Mavis Staples Takes Home 2 Grammys
item.description: The gospel-soul powerhouse won for her covers of songs by Kevin Morby and Frank Ocean, bringing her career total to five Grammy Awards ahead of a tour this spring.

item.title: Jesus And Mary Chain, Courtney Barnett Headline Memorial Day Weekend Fest At Salt Shed
item.description: The Warm Love Cool Dreams Music & Arts Festival returns May 23 and 24. Chicago acts set to perform include Tortoise, Whitney, Tobacco City, Pixel Grip and more.

item.title: South Side Irish Parade Names 2026 Grand Marshal And Honoree
item.description: The 48th South Side Irish Parade will step off on March 15 with representatives from the Tunnel to Towers Foundation and St. Christina Parish leading the annual march through Beverly and Morgan Park.
